title: designRequirements
description: Requirements a CONAS connector or connector accessory must comply with. Built on the PEAS designRequirementsBase mixin. The connectorFamily field aligns with connector.datasheetInfo.familyDetails.family and may constrain candidate selection; accessoryKind and hostSeries are the accessory-side equivalents, aligning with connectorAccessory.datasheetInfo.accessoryDetails.kind and .hostSystem.series. A requirements document constrains one or the other, never both.

connectorFamily.description: Required connector family (matches familyDetails.family). Omit to leave unconstrained.

accessoryKind.description: Required accessory class (matches connectorAccessory.datasheetInfo.accessoryDetails.kind). Refs the part-side anchor so the selection vocabulary cannot drift from the part vocabulary. Omit to leave unconstrained.

hostSeries.description: Required host connector system the accessory must fit (matches connectorAccessory.datasheetInfo.hostSystem.series, e.g. 'Mini-Fit Jr.'). This is the constraint that actually selects an accessory: the class alone does not, because a backshell only fits the series it was drawn for.

minimumPositions.description: Minimum number of contact positions required.

requiredCurrentPerContact.description: Required continuous current per contact, in A.

maximumContactResistance.description: Maximum acceptable per-contact (mated pair) resistance, in Ohm. Drives the conduction-loss budget and contact temperature rise; the librarian rejects parts whose electrical.contactResistance exceeds this. Migrated from the former PEAS terminal.designRequirements.contactResistanceMax.

ambientTemperatureRange.description: Required operating ambient range, in Celsius.
